mentions.claim_text: Praying for the bride, the church and the people to wake up, he says they must not look to a man to save the nation but to Jesus, and that only an awakening unto God will save America.
mentions.quote: it will only be an Awakening unto God that will save America
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim as given: a theological position stated in prayer, with no event or date.

mentions.claim_text: He describes channels with tens of thousands of subscribers and videos with over a million views using prophetic content to raise money from people.
mentions.quote: they're using that to get money for people
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: a criticism of other channels' monetisation.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts thanking God through a whole night for a hundred dollar water bill being paid, describing how little they had and how they still sowed a seed.
mentions.quote: I thank you for the water bill
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: personal testimony about gratitude and giving.

mentions.claim_text: He describes sowing whatever he had, five dollars or one, into what he calls good ground, testing the ground and moving on if it did not produce.
mentions.quote: I tested the ground. I test the ground
mentions.falsify_match: Not a forward claim: seed-faith teaching from his own history.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts acting on an idea he believed God gave him despite having no idea what he was doing and being low at the time.
mentions.quote: I believe he gave me this idea

mentions.claim_text: He says the Lord allowed him a glimpse inside himself, which he calls the most holy moment of his life, and stresses that it was only a glimpse of something far greater.
mentions.quote: the most holy moment in my life allowed me to see inside of him
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a private religious experience with no external referent.

mentions.claim_text: He describes glory domes to which people travel for miles from the east and west coasts, walking in and being healed, delivered and saved as part of a great revival.
mentions.quote: in these Glory domes people would come for miles and they would be healed
mentions.falsify_match: Large healing meetings under dome structures drawing people nationally.
mentions.falsify_miss: None appear. Undated. The dome detail is specific enough to recognise if it happens.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw great revival in America, in Europe, in Africa and everywhere, then breaks off to introduce the channel's new notification sound and ask for subscriptions.
mentions.quote: I saw great great Revival in Europe I saw great Revival in Africa
mentions.falsify_match: Simultaneous large-scale revival on several continents.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Undated and unmeasured, and revival is claimed continuously across the corpus.

mentions.claim_text: His wife reads out an email from another person on his behalf, prefacing it as something they received rather than something he was shown.
mentions.quote: this was in an email we got
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: a viewer's email read aloud by his wife.

mentions.claim_text: The email being read states that the Psalm 83 and Obadiah war is on the doorstep and cannot be held back much longer, that Middle East conflicts will escalate rapidly into full-scale war unless God's mercy holds them back, and that Israel will soon attack Iran to destroy its nuclear capability.
mentions.quote: the psalm 83 Obadiah war is on our doorstep now
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: this is another person's letter read on air, so under the corpus rule it does not enter as a word he gives.
mentions.falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded because he presents it approvingly alongside his own material.

mentions.claim_text: The same email continues that Damascus will be destroyed very soon according to Isaiah 17, with much collateral damage in both Israel and America, and that the West will be shaken to the core economically and spiritually.
mentions.quote: Damascus will be destroyed very soon according to Isaiah 17
mentions.falsify_match: Not his claim: continued reading of the viewer's letter.

mentions.claim_text: He reasons from the 70th anniversary of the Second World War victory that a special blessing of seventy years on America ended in 2015, and reads the pattern of grace periods God has given the nation as a warning.
mentions.quote: so it's 70 years the Lord said he was given us a special blessing
mentions.falsify_match: Unfalsifiable: a retrospective numerology of grace periods, with the terminal date already eleven years past when he gives it.

mentions.claim_text: He says nobody in Congress or the Senate will stop what he has seen coming, and that only the grace and mercy of God in a great revival, with preachers preaching the truth from the pulpits, will save America.
mentions.quote: not anybody in congress or senate will stop what I saw coming
mentions.falsify_match: Political action fails to avert the events he has described while revival averts them.
mentions.falsify_miss: Politics averts them, or nothing needs averting. Note this is the structure that makes the whole thread unfalsifiable: any political outcome is compatible with it.

mentions.claim_text: He recounts his mother finding a supernatural twenty dollar bill in her purse in the 1980s so the family could eat, and says God will come through in the same way.
mentions.falsify_match: Not a claim: a childhood anecdote used to teach on provision.

mentions.claim_text: Practical preparation advice: keep a car with good fuel economy rather than an electric one because air conditioning drains the battery, and ask a doctor about holding enough medication.
mentions.quote: having a car that gets good gas mileage

mentions.claim_text: He says that when China moves against Taiwan and the United States objects, some kinds of prescription medication, though not all, become very hard to get, naming blood pressure, diabetic and heart medicines.
mentions.quote: prescription medication and some kinds becoming very hard to get
mentions.falsify_match: Shortages of specific prescription drug classes following a Taiwan confrontation.
mentions.falsify_miss: No confrontation, or no shortage. The conditional structure is honest: it is tied to a named trigger rather than a date.

mentions.claim_text: He says he saw huge combines and tractors sitting dusty and unable to move, fields ploughed with no crops in them, and that when taken above the United States he saw no crops in any farmer's fields from west to east.
mentions.quote: from west to east there was no crops in any of the farmers Fields
mentions.falsify_match: A nationwide failure to plant or harvest across the United States.
mentions.falsify_miss: Normal planting and harvest. Undated, but a coast-to-coast crop failure would be unmissable, which makes this one of the more checkable food claims.
